Select: compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Source: molecule_dictionary, molecule_hierarchy, compound_structures, compound_records, docs, activities, assays, target_dictionary. Join: molecule_dictionary parent on chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1336'. Join molecule_hierarchy on parent_molregno = parent.molregno. Join molecule_dictionary child on molregno = hierarchy.molregno. Join compound_structures on molregno = child.molregno. Join compound_records on molregno = child.molregno. Join docs on doc_id = records.doc_id. Join activities on record_id = records.record_id. Join assays on assay_id = activities.assay_id. Join target_dictionary on tid = assays.tid. Filter: target_dictionary.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL279'. Filter: activities.standard_type = 'IC50'. Filter: activities.standard_units = 'nM'. Sort: compound_chembl_id ASC, compound_key ASC, pubmed_id_or_doi ASC, assay_description ASC, standard_type ASC, standard_relation ASC, standard_value ASC, standard_units ASC, target_chembl_id ASC, target_name ASC, target_organism ASC. Limit: None.
